meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 给你的 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 渠道:从 channels 分支复制并注册适配器、安装依赖,再选本地(macOS 读 chat.db)或远程(Photon API)模式,写入 .env、重启服务,并解析你的 iMessage 手机号或 Apple ID 作为对话地址。
howto.when: 当你提到「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词时触发。本地模式只在 macOS 上可用,其他系统只能选远程 Photon 模式。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage,用本地模式
say.note: 需 macOS,并给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问权限

say.text: 用 Photon 远程接入 iMessage
say.note: 接着会让你填 Photon 服务器地址和 API key
把这个号码解析为你的对话地址

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs its dependency, picks local (Mac chat.db) or remote (Photon API) mode, writes .env, restarts the service and resolves your iMessage handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" and similar phrases. Local mode works only on macOS; any other OS must use remote Photon mode.

say_en.text: Add iMessage to NanoClaw in local mode
say_en.note: macOS only; grant Full Disk Access to Node

say_en.text: Connect iMessage via Photon remote mode
say_en.note: You'll then be asked for the server URL and API key
Resolves your handle as the conversation address
